reproductions.title: Paper Raft study: transduced-lm-2026
reproductions.summary: Five agents each implemented one estimator from the paper (beam summing, smc_simple, smc_rb, beam_swor, beam_swor_adaptive) and were graded against the claim the paper makes for it. All five pass: smc_simple, smc_rb and beam_swor are exact in the Appendix E worst case; the four unbiased estimators stay within 4 standard errors of the exact value over 128 seeds on a DNA bigram, with error falling as M grows; beam summing is a lower bound matching Fig. 1. The error ordering matches the paper's Table 2: beam_swor ≈ beam_swor_adaptive < smc_rb < smc_simple.
reproductions.limits: Claims only, not Table 2's numbers: the paper does not name its DNA corpus or targets, so the bigram and three targets are stand-ins. The WikiText-2/PTB text and GPT-2 experiments are not covered. Remainder entries, the tail roulette for the beam estimators and beam_swor_adaptive's budget shrinking are never triggered by the graded runs.
